class.name: BoneRotationOffsetModifier3D
class.brief_description: Applies a weighted rotation offset to a sequence of bones.
class.description: Applies a weighted rotation offset to each named bone. When [member rotation_offsets] is empty, [member rotation_offset] is used for every bone. Otherwise, each entry in [member rotation_offsets] corresponds to the bone at the same index in [member bone_names]. The rotation is blended from identity by the corresponding value in [member rotation_weights] and the modifier's [member SkeletonModifier3D.influence]. A missing weight defaults to [code]1.0[/code]. [member rotation_space] determines whether the legacy sequential offset is applied in each bone's local space or in skeleton space. When [member use_initial_global_pose] is enabled, each per-bone offset is applied to the global rotation captured at the start of this modifier, in parent-before-child order. This prevents a parent offset from being accumulated again into a child's target. Local translations and scales are preserved. When packed blend samples are set, the effective per-bone rotation offset is slerped between the corresponding entries using [member rotation_offset_blend_weight]. Setting [member rotation_offsets], [member rotation_offset], or calling [method clear_rotation_offsets] exits packed blend-sample mode.

method.name: get_bone_names
method.description: Returns the bone names that receive the rotation offset.

method.name: get_bone_rotation_offset
method.description: Returns the per-bone offset at [param index], or the shared [member rotation_offset] when no per-bone value is set.

method.name: get_rotation_offsets
method.description: Returns the optional per-bone rotation offsets.

method.name: get_rotation_space
method.description: Returns the space in which the rotation offset is applied.

method.name: is_using_initial_global_pose
method.description: Returns whether per-bone offsets use the global rotations captured at the start of this modifier.

method.name: clear_rotation_offsets
method.description: Clears per-bone offsets so the shared offset is used.

method.name: set_bone_names
method.description: Sets the bone names that receive the rotation offset.

method.name: set_bone_rotation_offset
method.description: Sets the per-bone offset at [param index].

method.name: set_rotation_offsets
method.description: Sets the optional per-bone rotation offsets.

method.name: set_rotation_offsets_packed
method.description: Sets the optional per-bone rotation offsets from packed quaternion components in x, y, z, w order. Non-finite and zero-length entries become identity rotations.

method.name: set_rotation_offset_blend_samples_packed
method.description: Sets two packed per-bone quaternion samples for interpolation. Both arrays must have the same size; a mismatch returns [code]false[/code] and leaves the current values unchanged. Entries are normalized once when set, with non-finite and zero-length entries replaced by identity.

method.name: set_rotation_offset_blend_weight
method.description: Sets the interpolation weight between the packed samples. The value is clamped to [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_rotation_offset_blend_weight
method.description: Returns the interpolation weight between the packed samples.

method.name: set_rotation_space
method.description: Sets the space in which the rotation offset is applied.

method.name: set_use_initial_global_pose
method.description: Sets whether per-bone offsets use the global rotations captured at the start of this modifier.

members.member: Names of the bones that receive the rotation offset, processed in array order.
Shared rotation offset used when [member rotation_offsets] is empty or lacks the bone's index.
Optional offset for each bone in [member bone_names] order.
Interpolation weight between the two packed blend samples.
Space in which the rotation offset is applied.
Per-bone rotation weights. Entries outside [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] are clamped.
Applies per-bone offsets to global rotations captured before this modifier runs, in parent-before-child order.

constants.constant: Apply the offset in local bone space.
Apply the offset in skeleton space.
